create_LEDConfig_default: create a default LEDConfig instance for the allenai/led-base-16384 model
create_LEDConfig_custom: create an LEDConfig with custom encoder layers, d_model, and attention_window parameters
create_LEDConfig_from_dict: create an LEDConfig instance from a dictionary of configuration parameters
create_LEDModel_with_config: create an LEDModel using an LEDConfig instance for initialization
read_LEDConfig_attributes: read LEDConfig attributes like vocab_size, d_model, and attention_window
